effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer or [Hybrid] trait Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait or [Ten Warriors] trait from your trash to the hand. Then, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Ten Warriors] trait or 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand with the play cost reduced by 4.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card with an inherited effect from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
